scope: Local simulation observation panel; no agent motion commands, push or publication

electron.validation: Native window capture and Windows UI Automation
electron.source_finding: HTTP protocol handler forwards Core and pet origins only; isLocal is not the final access check
electron.old_0_2_9_module_error: Resolved by refreshing the native window after version 0.2.10 activation

image_transport.display: Blob object URL; revoked on replacement and unmount

limitations: 3D PNGs require an open, updating workbench page; otherwise the panel shows a labeled SDF truth position map
Neither image source is a camera or SLAM result

User operated the simulation during observation; those motions are not claimed as agent acceptance actions
